name: tw-price-checker
description: Paste a Taiwan e-commerce product link (momo, PChome, Yahoo, Rakuten, Ruten) to see how its listed price has changed over time, a summary of buyer reviews, where else the same model is sold, and better-reviewed alternatives. Shopee links are not supported.

interface.longDescription: Savingsbot (輕鬆省輕鬆報): Paste a product link from a Taiwan online store (momo, PChome, Yahoo, Rakuten, Ruten) and get one report: how the product's listed price has changed over time on BigGo, a summary of buyer reviews with sources, where else the same model is sold, and up to three better-reviewed alternatives with a spec comparison and links. You can also ask for a daily check that tells you when the listed price falls below a level you set. Uses ChatGPT's browser and web search. Limitations: Shopee links are not supported; results depend on what each website shows at the time; this plugin never places orders or signs in to stores.
defaultPrompt: 幫我看看這個商品值不值得買：
這個商品哪裡買最便宜？
這個商品降價時通知我

zh-TW.subtitle: 輕鬆省輕鬆報：比價看評價
zh-TW.description: 輕鬆省輕鬆報（Savingsbot）：貼上台灣電商（momo、PChome、Yahoo、樂天、露天）的商品網址，就產出一份報告：BigGo 上的價格走勢、附來源的買家評價摘要、同型號還有哪些通路在賣，以及最多三個評價更好的替代品（附規格比較和連結）。也可以設定每天檢查一次，價格低於你設定的數字時通知你。使用 ChatGPT 的瀏覽器與網路搜尋。不支援蝦皮；不會代為下單或登入任何網站。
